AVOCADOMINI / CROWDFUNDING CONCEPT

From concept
to prototype.

avocadoMini is a kit concept with four Motion Towers and one Edge Hub. It is currently at the P0.2 design stage. Funding, payments, and early reservations have not started.

01 / FIRST MILESTONE

Validate it with a prototype first.

  1. Bench-test the telescoping mechanism, deployable feet, dock detection, and safety stop.
  2. Test four-tower synchronization, startup scanning, and work-zone calibration.
  3. Measure the display pipeline and user experience from the Edge Hub to external devices.

02 / PRICE

Planned pre-order price for the four-tower kit (before tax): ¥410,000

This is the P0.2 target for four towers plus one Edge Hub, not the price of a single tower. Tax, shipping, and delivery terms are not yet finalized.

Funding has not started

The funding platform, target, rewards, and delivery terms are still undecided. Planned pricing and availability are shown on the pre-order page.
